description: This file sets up a video test source pipeline using GStreamer within the Pipecat framework. It defines configuration parameters, initializes GStreamer pipeline sources, and orchestrates running this pipeline as part of a bot that can be integrated into a larger video processing system.

classes.name: GStreamerPipelineSource
classes.description: Class providing GStreamer pipeline source configuration for video streaming.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Class representing a generic processing pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Class encapsulating a pipeline task with an optional idle timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Class managing the execution of a processing pipeline.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the GStreamer video test pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the pipeline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that invokes the main runner from Pipecat to start the application.
